chunks.text: Today, we will talk about Panama.
Panama is a small but very important country in Central America.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Panama?
Panama is in Central America.
It connects North America and South America.
It is between Costa Rica and Colombia.
To the north is the Caribbean Sea, and to the south is the Pacific Ocean.
Panama is famous for the Panama Canal, which links the two oceans.
What is the capital city of Panama?
The capital city is Panama City.
Panama City is modern, with tall buildings, shops, and hotels.
It also has an old town called Casco Viejo, with colorful streets and history.
The Panama Canal is close to the city, and many ships pass through it every day.
How many people live in Panama?
About 4.5 million people live in Panama.
Many people live in cities near the coast, but there are also small towns and villages.
Panama has many different cultures, including indigenous communities, Afro -Caribbean people, and people from Spain, China, and other countries.
What language people speak in Panama?
The official language is Spanish.
People speak Spanish at home, in school, and in business.
Many people also speak English, especially in Panama City and tourist areas.
Some indigenous groups speak Nguyebara, Guna, and other native languages.
What is the weather like in Panama?
Panama is hot and humid all year.
It has a tropical climate.
There are two main seasons, dry season, from December to April, rainy season, from May to November.
Even in the rainy season, the sun often shines between showers.
What does Panama look like?
Panama has beaches on both oceans, rainforests with many plants and animals, mountains and volcanoes, rivers, islands, and green hills.
The country is full of nature and biodiversity.
It is a great place for hiking, swimming, and exploring.
What animals live in Panama?
Panama has many animals like monkeys, sloths, toucans, parrots, frogs, lizards, and butterflies.
In the sea, there are dolphins, whales, turtles, and fish.
Panama is home to part of the Amazon rainforest, so it has rich wildlife.
What do people eat in Panama?
Panamanian food is simple, tasty, and full of flavor.
People eat rice and beans, plantains, like bananas but cooked, chicken, beef, and fish.
Corn -based dishes.

Some popular foods are sancocho, chicken soup with vegetables, a roast compoyo, rice with chicken, empanadas, fried pastries with meat or cheese, tamales, corn with filling, steamed in leaves, for dessert, coconut sweets, flan, or fruit like pineapple and mango.
What do people drink in Panama?
People drink coffee.
Panama has very good coffee.
Fruit juices made with mango, papaya, or guava.
Chicha, a sweet drink made from fruit or corn.
Water, tea, and sometimes soft drinks.
In the hot weather, drinks are usually served cold.
What is life like in Panama?
Life in Panama is often relaxed and friendly.
People enjoy time with family and friends.
In cities, people go to work, school, and shops.
In the countryside, people farm, fish, or make crafts.
Many people enjoy dancing music like salsa and reggae.
Visiting the beach, celebrating local festivals.
What are some holidays and traditions in Panama?
Carnival, before Lent, with music, dancing, and parades.
Independence Day, November 3rd, Flag Day, Colon Day, and Shout in Villadello Santos, also in November.
Christmas and New Years with family, fireworks, and food.
People wear traditional clothes, play drums, and enjoy folk dances.
Some fun facts about Panama.
The Panama Canal opened in 1914 and is very important for global trade.
You can watch the sunrise in the Pacific and sunset in the Atlantic in one day.
The Panama Hat actually comes from Ecuador, but it became famous in Panama.
Panama has over 1,400 islands.
The flag is red, white, and blue with two stars.
Now you know many things about Panama.
You know where it is, what people speak, and what the weather is like.
You learned about the food, animals, cities, and traditions.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emili.
